div.head: Annex

p.hi: Points To Be Considered in Drafting the “Convention”

list.label: (a)
list.item: The determination of Element “A” for the metropolitan component (the “police” forces foreseen in President Hoover’s proposal for home countries).
list.label: (b)
list.item: The determination of the number of overseas forces (some reduction over the status quo if possible).
list.label: (c)
list.item: An agreement not to increase the total land forces.
list.label: (d)
list.item: An agreement in principle on similarity of type for European continental land armies.

list.label: (a)
list.item: A limitation by numbers of all mobile land artillery above 105 mm.
list.label: (c)
list.item: An undertaking not to construct mobile land artillery above 155 mm.
list.label: (c)
list.item: Some scrapping of heavy mobile land artillery and in addition the conversion from mobile to fixed mounts of a certain proportion of the remaining heavy mobile land artillery.

list.label: (a)
list.item: Scrap tanks above . . . . . tons.
list.label: (b)
list.item: Limitation by numbers of tanks below . . . . . tons.

list.label: (a)
list.item: Universal abolition of aerial bombing.
list.label: (b)
list.item: Prohibition of peacetime preparation and training in bombing.
list.label: (c)
list.item: Convert or scrap bombing planes.
list.label: (d)
list.item: Limitation by numbers of military planes.
list.label: (e)
list.item: Full publicity as to type and characteristics of civil planes registered or constructed, with possibly some further measures of control applicable to Europe.

list.label: (a)
list.item: Universal abolition of use of chemical warfare.
list.label: (b)
list.item: An agreement not to make preparation for or to train in the offensive use of chemical warfare in peacetime.

list.label: (a)
list.item: Completion of London Treaty by France and Italy.
list.label: (b)
list.item: Nations not parties to the Washington and London Treaties to accept a limitation of types so as not to prejudice the restrictions on type which already govern the leading naval Powers.

p.hi: 7. Manufacture of and Trade in Arms.

list.label: (a)
list.item: Recognize the principle of State supervision of private manufacture.
list.label: (b)
list.item: Recognize the principle of equality of publicity for State and private manufacture.
list.label: (c)
list.item: Recognize the principle of control and publicity for export and import.

div.p: The Permanent Disarmament Commission to be set up as envisaged in the Draft Convention with amendments as now being drafted after recent discussions in the Bureau.

list.label: (a)
list.item: An agreement not to increase the totals of armaments as existing or as fixed by other treaties limiting armaments, during the life of the Convention, with the necessary exception that, in accordance with the provisions of the Convention, certain specified amounts of defensive material might be added to the armaments of those nations lacking such weapons.
list.label: (b)
list.item: The Convention should likewise specify that the parties to it should neither build nor permit to be manufactured within their territories any types of weapons not expressly stipulated in the Convention.
